resources.name: CeO2 bulk crystal structure (cubic fluorite, space group Fm-3m, lattice parameter a = 5.48 Å)

access.notes: Can be generated from the known lattice parameter and atomic positions (Ce at 0.25,0.25,0.25; O at 0,0,0 and 0.5,0,0) or taken from a public database such as ICSD 72155.

resources.notes: The (111) surface slab is constructed from this bulk structure.

resources.name: Open-source periodic DFT code (e.g., Quantum ESPRESSO, CP2K, or equivalent) with PAW/pseudopotential and GGA+U support

access.notes: Any code capable of spin-polarised DFT+U on periodic slabs with PAW potentials is acceptable.

resources.name: PAW pseudopotential library for Ce, Cu, Cr, O (PBE exchange-correlation, with Ce 4f electrons in valence)

access.notes: Use the SSSP library or the pseudopotential library of the chosen DFT code; ensure the potentials include Ce 4f states as valence.

resources.name: Bader charge analysis code (e.g., Henkelman group's Bader program)

access.notes: Open-source tool for partitioning charge density; used to obtain Bader charges on Cu and Cr.
